study_design: Case-control study of incident prostate cancer
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Cases were 320 patients with histologically confirmed incident disease, whereas controls were 246 patients without history or symptomatology of benign prostatic hyperplasia, treated in the same hospitals as the cases for minor diseases or conditions.
reason: The abstract reports histologically confirmed incident prostate cancer but does not analyze an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There was also no evidence for a positive association between vertex baldness, tobacco smoking and drinking of coffee or alcoholic beverages, on the one hand, and PC, on the other.
estimate_classifications.reason: The alcohol estimate concerns overall incident prostate cancer; no aggressive endpoint is identified.
